summary: Refactor: remove unreleased legacy cluster-layout upgrade code and dead functions, consolidate duplicated atomic-write and trusted-path helpers, and move the Controller storage-cluster broker map onto the Controller. API impact: none.

guide.reason: The guide no longer describes an in-place upgrade of an older cluster CIB layout; a non-current CIB is refused and reported as requiring attention.

api.reason: Reference wording only: docs/API.md drops the removed legacy-CIB upgrade. Endpoints, schemas, authentication and errors are unchanged; a non-current CIB is refused without a write as a foreign one already was.

roadmap.reason: Code-quality cleanup within current network storage scope.

state.reason: No durable setting added or moved. Existing Core master records keep their formats; the Controller broker map is transient per-process state now scoped to its Controller.

verification.method: Go vet, normal and race suites for agent, vmhost and controller; independent review; clean rebuild deployed to the disposable three-Core lab with idle health and SMB, NFS and clustered-iSCSI GFS2 workloads rerun, recorded in the QA follow-up.
